name: @flash-erp/store-desktop
description: Flash ERP store desktop point-of-sale and sync runtime.
author: Flash Code Solutions

scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.build:deps: npm --workspace @flash-erp/domain run build && npm --workspace @flash-erp/sync-core run build
scripts.stage:package-runtime: npm run stage:workspace-deps && npm run stage:sync-runtime-deps
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage:package-runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage:package-runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs && npm run verify:win-signature
scripts.dist:win:unsigned: npm run build && npm run stage:package-runtime && set "FLASH_ERP_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_WINDOWS_BUILD=1" && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.publish:win: npm run build && npm run stage:package-runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always --config electron-builder.config.cjs && npm run verify:win-signature
scripts.store-server: npm run build:deps && npm run build:main && node ./dist-electron/src/main/store-server-entry.js
